name: claude-provider-switcher
description: Run Kimi K3 and other Synthetic models in Anthropic's Claude Code editor extension, with per-role routing and live quota status.

scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run compile:integration && node ./scripts/run-integration.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run compile
scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run check && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out synthetic-for-claude-code-1.2.7.vsix

claudeProvider.confirmBeforeReload.description: Confirm before changing provider and reloading the Cursor window.

claudeProvider.synthetic.defaultModel.description: Synthetic model used as Claude Code's default model. Advanced syn: automatic routes are also supported.

claudeProvider.synthetic.opusModel.description: Synthetic model used for Opus requests. Advanced syn: automatic routes are also supported.

claudeProvider.synthetic.sonnetModel.description: Synthetic model used for Sonnet requests. Advanced syn: automatic routes are also supported.

claudeProvider.synthetic.haikuModel.description: Synthetic model used for Haiku requests. Advanced syn: automatic routes are also supported.

claudeProvider.synthetic.subagentModel.description: Synthetic model used for Claude Code subagents. Advanced syn: automatic routes are also supported.

claudeProvider.synthetic.usageRefreshMin.description: Minutes between Synthetic rolling quota refreshes while Synthetic is active. Set to 0 for manual refresh only.

claudeProvider.preserveSharedPreferences.description: Preserve existing shared Claude Code traffic and attribution preferences when switching. Unrelated environment variables are always preserved.
